proposal.observation: Stage 1 is locked (residual 2.80 cm). Ring count is already exact: ten magenta ring mid-lines and ring_count_error 0. The weak proxy term is correspondence_f1@15 0.364 (chamfer_sym_px 75.3, boundary_explained_edge@25 0.474); sam_fill_rate 0.729 and depth_nan_ratio 0.131 are secondary. On detected_lines, red is positive-angle oblique, green is negative-angle oblique, blue is horizontal. Only one negative-angle track (about y 1450-1500) and one positive-angle track (about y 1620-1650, fragmented and fading on the right where the depth void is) survive; their separation is about 165-170 px, matching K_height 823.8 mm at 5 mm/px. Other block boundaries visible in the segmentation bands have no oblique line. A few isolated blue horizontals sit off those tracks. All ten prompt centres are labelled propagated and lie on one row at y about 1553, while the oblique tracks themselves drift about 40-50 px across the span (phase_incoherence 1.1 deg).
proposal.rule: If ring_count_error is already 0, oblique yield is only the K-edge pair, other block boundaries still have partial edge support, and uniform_k_snap has collapsed every prompt onto one design row while the joint tracks slope, treat it as missing oblique lines plus a flat K snap. Do not retune unfolding or the vertical Hough threshold.
proposal.rationale: Correspondence is the harmonic mean of detected joint lines and SAM block boundaries at 15 px. The lines that exist sit on the K edges, so most of the 75 px chamfer is block boundaries with no line, not a bad ring count. Lower curvature_threshold from 0.0005 to 0.00035 so fainter non-K joints enter the outlier map before detection. Lower binary_threshold from 127 to 114 and hough_threshold_oblique from 30 to 24, and raise maxLineGap_oblique from 30 to 45, to keep the weaker gapped oblique segments on those boundaries; the real joints are in the plus/minus 4-10 deg taper window, not the horizontal fallback. Raise hough_threshold_horizontal from 30 to 45 so the isolated blue horizontals do not add unexplained line pixels. Set uniform_k_snap false so each ring keeps its measured K Y instead of all ten being forced to 1553, letting the block stack follow the same about 1 deg track the oblique lines already follow. Leave segment_width, K_height, angle, denoising, and hough_threshold_vertical at the reference: ring pitch and the K gap already match, and the worked full overlays on the development continuous case jointly lowered correspondence and fill.
